messages:
toni: Noticed a reproducible-ish failure while bringing up magnet-32k int4 on perf nodes: prefill ~12k, append ~6k, resume -> sometimes 4-6 tokens repeat and KV fingerprint diverges. ~1/400.

jas: Which runtime / policy? fold or reset?

toni: Using kv_policy=fold (we need low latency). reset fixes it every time but unacceptable perf hit.

harper: Any logs/snippets? Could be RoPE phase continuity or a metadata race during append merge.

toni: Snip: [cache] prefill fp=0x4a1b len=12032 slot=11
[cache] append fp=0x4a1c len+=6144 slot=11
gen: idx=12036 tok=211 dup span=12034-12039
[cache] fp_mismatch expected=0x4a1b got=0x4a1c

jas: Interesting that slot stays same. I suspect append metadata gets written without ordering barrier; on arm64 we saw similar sheen. Try atomic CAS for fingerprint update.

harper: Also add a per-layer phase checksum after stitch to validate RoPE continuity. If checksum differs then it's phase application bug not race.

toni: I'll add a tiny unit test that does: seed RNG, prefill/append/resume loop 50k times under qemu-int4 and capture phase checksums + slot dumps on failure. Uploading rig now.

qa-bot: Created ticket #5049: "magnet32k split-replay race vs rope-phase continuity" (reporter: toni) :gear: 

jas: If CAS/atomic fixes repro in unit runs, we can replace global lock with atomic CAS on fingerprint and a lightweight memory barrier. If phase checksum still fails after that, dig into stitcher posscale clamp.

harper: Agreed. Also test toggling "force-continuous-pos" in stitcher; if forcing continuity removes the issue it points at phase re-eval bug.

toni: Running 50k now (qemu int4). Will post results + artifact link. Keeping config toggles documented in the ticket. :eyes:
